segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַגּוֹזֵל וּמַאֲכִיל אֶת בָּנָיו, וְהִנִּיחַ לִפְנֵיהֶם – פְּטוּרִין מִלְּשַׁלֵּם. וְאִם הָיָה דָּבָר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ אַחְרָיוּת – חַיָּיבִין לְשַׁלֵּם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who robs» another of food «and feeds» it to «his children, or» who «left» a stolen item «to them» and then died, the children «are exempt from paying» the victim of the robbery after their father’s death. But «if» the stolen item «was something that serves» as a legal «guarantee» of a loan, the heirs «are obligated to pay.»

moves.summary: children fed or left stolen goods are exempt from paying

moves.cueHe: ואם היה דבר שיש בו אחריות
moves.summary: but if it is guaranteed property the heirs must pay

positions.claim: heirs fed or left stolen goods are exempt; if the item serves as a guarantee they must pay
